hypothesis.claim: On the immutable terminal v1 trace and manifest, the exact 63-step unsigned-__int128 Q63 posterior retains at least 40,163,160 D mixture-gain bits, remains positive in every third, and beats S/R/N globally and in every third.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire physical Endpoint428 HORIZON-A if any frozen predicate fails under exact arithmetic, regardless of the legacy floating result.

changedMechanism: Change only posterior division from long-double scaling to exact 63-bit quotient generation with half-up remainder rounding; preserve all v1 inputs, endpoints, controls, schedules, clamps, and thresholds.
invariants: Execution refuses before reading the v1 trace or manifest unless v1 is terminal and has a valid reflection bound to its decision hash.
The terminal v1 parent.p1, manifest-a.bin, and analysis-a.json paths, byte counts, and SHA-256 values are inherited from the terminal v1 decision.
Probability scale is 65536, posterior total is 2^63, initial parent weight is 2^62, rounding is nearest with exact halves upward, and clamps are [1,2^63-1].
Exactly 63 quotient bits are generated in unsigned __int128; no floating-point value participates in the exact posterior state transition.
D/S/R/N KT states, byte-to-bit endpoint, mixture count, update order, global posterior scope, third boundaries, and 40,163,160-bit threshold are unchanged.
The exact analyzer also reproduces the complete legacy trajectory and must match the terminal v1 analysis before the exact decision has authority.
Two full analyzers over identical immutable inputs must emit byte-identical analysis JSON.
This experiment changes no coded probability and has no archive or score authority.
